newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit rangebound in late KL, awaits fresh leads.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit rangebound in late KL, awaits fresh leads.

text.p: The ringgit was rangebound in late Asian trading as profit-taking halted its rise and lack of fresh leads reduced activity in the afternoon, dealers said.
They said the ringgit was unlikely to move very much later in London or New York, though sentiment remained in favour of the Malaysian unit.
"It should remain in the 2.4760-90 range for the rest of the day," a dealer with a foreign bank in Malaysia said.
The ringgit reversed a four-week long downtrend as U.S. funds returned to the Malaysian unit from the Singapore dollar for higher yield and stronger fundamentals.
"There was not much momentum in Tuesday's rally. It was done in thin London market, but market should be able to hold the gains," said a dealer with a Singapore-based European bank.
He said many investors were taking advantage of the arbitrage opportunities created by the rise in Malaysian interest rates over the last two weeks.
"After failing to break 2.5140 last week, the funds are buying dollar/Sing and dumping dollar/Malay," a dealer with another Singapore-based European bank said.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4968/78 a dollar.
